title: Virginia Data Center Load Trip and Grid Reliability
discussion_signal: The post describes a large Virginia computational-load event and frames it as a grid-planning problem involving power electronics, ride-through standards, and coordination among operators, utilities, regulators, and data-center owners.
linked_research_question: How should grid operators govern large computational loads after a real operating event moves data-center dependency from forecast risk into response rules?
limits: The post is a practitioner interpretation of an operating event
It does not independently verify all event figures
